central_claim: Across the EMC reports this repository's citation set contains, the NR4A3 5' fusion partner is a candidate — not established — stratification variable. On prognosis, two non-overlapping cohorts (Agaram 2014, Huang 2023) pool to 73 patients and give a crude disease-specific-death contrast of 7/15 = 46.7% (Wilson 24.8–69.9) with TAF15::NR4A3 against 6/58 = 10.3% (4.8–20.8) with EWSR1::NR4A3, post-hoc Fisher p = 0.0034 — a magnitude that arrives with a defeater from ONE of those two cohorts' own authors (Huang 2023: the partner loses significance once tumour size > 10 cm and metastasis at presentation are adjusted for). Local recurrence (26.7% vs 22.4%) and distant metastasis (33.3% vs 24.1%) separate on neither. On treatment response, the entire examined TAF15 antiangiogenic experience is 0 of 3 (pazopanib trial alone, the only POLICY-conformant pool) to 0 of 5 (both cohorts, assuming independence), Wilson upper bound 43.4–56.1%, which sits above the comparator arm's own point estimate in both analyses — a direction with no magnitude. TAF15::NR4A3 is 28/154 = 18.2% (12.9–25.0) of partner-assigned EMC across four pooled series, below the ~27% the field quotes from one referral-centre cohort. All of that reproduces from the committed artifact; the document's own accounting of it does not.

scope_note: Five blockers and six P1s, and the split between measurement and inference is sharp here. NOTHING I found is a measurement defect in the pooling itself: every count, proportion, Wilson bound and Fisher p-value in the artifact reproduces from the raw integers under my own independent implementations, the artifact regenerates byte-for-byte from its generator, and the prose's arithmetic agrees with it. RG-B4 is the only pure measurement defect and it is a count OF THE ARTIFACT'S OWN RECORDS (11 vs 12), not of any patient. Everything else is a REPORTING defect of one shape: a correction that landed in one copy of a claim and not the others. RG-B2 and RG-B3 are the same defect twice in the same file — §2.5's superseded stratum range and A14's retracted 'four independent lines' both still stand in `emc_fusion_partner_pooling.py`, and RG-B2 additionally still stands in the committed artifact, which the paper instructs readers to treat as authoritative over the prose. RG-B1 is the most consequential because it is not internal bookkeeping: it states that Paioli 2021 ran a multivariable model in which the partner lost independence, which the artifact does not support and which two other sections of the same document contradict. RG-B5 is an inference defect — the Abstract claims exhaustiveness over the published literature that the stated method (no database query, no screening flow, no second reader) cannot deliver, and the artifact says so in capitals. Direction of error matters and is mixed: RG-B1 and RG-B5 both make the paper sound MORE certain than its own artifact, while the P1 about the omitted Sjögren 2003 series costs the paper a point in its own favour. None of the defects changes a single pooled number, so the central claim as the artifacts support it survives intact — but five of the sentences the paper uses to describe its own evidence do not, and four of them are in the parts a reader meets first (Abstract, §1.2 table, §3.4 opening, §8's integrity audit).
